verdicts.quote: Without the waitlisted member doing anything, the earliest eligible waitlisted member becomes booked in the class.
Waitlist order is the order in which members joined, earliest first, and nothing else changes it ... whatever the two members' tenure, plan or booking history; no joins ever share a position.
there is no refusal for holding several entries, including for two classes that overlap in time.
verdicts.missing: What happens to the entry for the overlapping class when the member is promoted into one of them (kept, removed, or booking both allowed).

verdicts.quote: Any existing cutoff, late-cancellation penalty or credit refund applies identically, with no extra grace for having been promoted late.
The cancellation (or the capacity increase, or other event) and the resulting promotions succeed or fail together
They receive a message through the same means the app uses to confirm a direct booking, naming the class, its date and time, saying the place came from the waitlist, and saying how to cancel.
two members cancelling at the same moment book the first two waitlisted members, never the same member twice, and places taken never exceeds 10 afterwards.
A member who obtains a booking in the class through any path other than promotion has their entry removed
verdicts.missing: How a simultaneous direct booking by the same waitlisted member and their promotion resolve (only leave-vs-promotion races are specified in C-35).

verdicts.quote: Promotion takes from the member whatever a direct booking would take, at the moment of promotion, and joining the waitlist takes nothing
With 20 active entries, a 21st member's join is refused with a message that the waitlist is full, and no entry is created
An entry stops being active when booking closes for the class and no promotion occurs after that
A capacity raised from 10 to 13 with 5 waiting books the first 3 eligible members in order and leaves the other 2 waiting at positions 1 and 2
Every active entry is removed, no promotion occurs, and each waitlisted member receives a message naming the class and saying it was cancelled
A member's position is 1 plus the number of active entries ahead of theirs
An entry stops being active when booking closes for the class
verdicts.missing: Whether inactive entries are kept or deleted after the class runs, and for how long.

verdicts.quote: No page or message addressed to a member shows another member's name, contact or account details through the waitlist; a member sees only their own position.
No control in the staff view adds, removes, reorders or promotes an entry
verdicts.missing: Whether staff can see who was promoted and when (a promotion history); manual promote/remove is decided against.

verdicts.quote: the waitlisted member already holds the place; no instant exists at which the opening is bookable directly.
A member booking a class with a free place gets a booking and the same confirmation and charge as before; no waitlist step appears.
classes already full show the join control and an empty waitlist.
